SELECT 
    jsonb_extract_path_text(qa.assessment_summary, 'condition', 'item_condition') AS item_condition,
    ROUND(AVG(CAST(fm.cost_breakdown->'disposal'->>'disposal_cost' AS numeric)), 2) AS avg_disposal_cost,
    ROUND(AVG(CAST(fm.cost_breakdown->'sustainability'->>'carbon_footprint' AS numeric)), 2) AS avg_carbon_footprint,
    ROUND(AVG(
        CAST(fm.cost_breakdown->'fees'->>'qa_fee' AS numeric) +
        CAST(fm.cost_breakdown->'fees'->>'restocking_fee' AS numeric) +
        CAST(fm.cost_breakdown->'fees'->>'relabeling_cost' AS numeric) +
        CAST(fm.cost_breakdown->'disposal'->>'disposal_cost' AS numeric) +
        COALESCE(CAST(fm.cost_breakdown->'repair_costs'->>'repair_estimate' AS numeric), 0)
    ), 2) AS avg_total_return_cost
FROM returns r
JOIN financial_management fm ON r.casenum = fm.casetag
JOIN quality_assessment qa ON r.casenum = qa.inspectref
WHERE fm.cost_breakdown->'disposal'->>'disposal_method' IN ('Landfill', 'Hazardous Waste')
GROUP BY jsonb_extract_path_text(qa.assessment_summary, 'condition', 'item_condition')
ORDER BY item_condition;
